abstract: Wifite but USB-only & cross-platform.wifit3 A standalone USB Wi-Fi auditor for Linux, Windows, and macOS. At least one of the supported USB adapters is required. Why? You can’t automate what you can’t measure. This means that evals are one of the gates to diffusion of AI in the enterprise. We can test our deterministic processes through software, but most enterprises have no useful way of understanding how their non-deterministic processes are working today. Specifically the work that agents are doing for them. Evals are mission critical for enterprises adopting AI because you have no other way of knowing what’s working, what’s broken, what changed, what improved, what you can do more of, etc. if you don’t have a good sense of how agents work in your environment today. All changes, upgrades, and deployments are downstream from good evals. Not only are we going to get vastly more domain specific evals over time for the labs and across the industry, but every enterprise will also need a clear sense of how agents are performing in their environment as well. Huge opportunity.
